name: Radon V3
headline: Four years in. A whole new chapter.
summary: A fresh look, more worlds to play in, and better tools for the people who keep your community going. This is Radon, renewed.
status: V3 preview · Full launch planned after Discord intent approval.

improvements.now: Three supported games, separate saved accounts, optional coupon alerts, and a 24-hour Supporter Pass. Basic claiming stays free.

improvements.area: Context that stays with an action
improvements.before: Warnings, severity-based actions, and editable mod logs.
improvements.now: Those tools stay, joined by searchable case history, private staff notes, audited reason edits, and member message reports.

improvements.area: A calmer way to get set up
improvements.before: Interactive setup for staff roles and moderation logs.
improvements.now: A four-step setup with review before saving, optional report routing and observation rules, plus /doctor to check readiness.

improvements.before: Staff-led moderation and configurable warning actions.
improvements.now: Opt-in native presets, flood and link rules, and join-burst response. Observe first; enable enforcement when it suits your server.

improvements.before: Channel locks, bans, and warning updates without the new recovery safeguards.
improvements.now: Locks restore saved permissions, temporary bans keep their unban schedules through restarts, and warning writes handle concurrent staff actions.

improvements.before: Command help and feedback spread across older message layouts.
improvements.now: Consistent Discord cards, contextual /help, claim progress feedback, visual web guides, private /bug reports, and the same /updates history here and in Discord.
